essence: The practitioner should worship the six limbs on the deity's limbs and then continue worship.
The practitioner should worship Kaustubha on the neck and then proceed.
Obeisance should be offered to the bird-king on the forehead and in the pericarp.
After that, one invokes Puruṣottama, the abode of Lakshmi.
The invoked form is characterized as maddening all women's hearts and inflaming passion.
